Upcoming Event San Francisco Upcoming Event | May 6, 2027 Learn more Upcoming Event London Upcoming Event | September 23, 2027 Learn more Frequently Asked Questions What is DX Annual? DX Annual is DX's flagship conference for developer productivity leaders navigating the AI era. Designed specifically for senior executives, VPs, and heads of DevProd, the single-day event brings together industry leaders to address the core challenges of modern engineering organizations, including applying AI across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), scaling engineering practices, and evolving the role of developer platform teams. Building on its inaugural 2026 event, which gathered ~500 senior leaders from companies like Netflix, Pinterest, Dropbox, Dell, and Nationwide, DX Annual is expanding into a two-city global series in 2027, featuring standalone conferences in both San Francisco and London. Why do I need to request an invite to attend DX Annual? DX Annual is intentionally curated to ensure the conversations are relevant, practical, and valuable for everyone in the room. By asking attendees to apply, we're able to bring together leaders facing similar challenges so discussions go deeper and every connection is with a genuine peer. When and where are the 2027 events? In 2027, DX Annual will expand to two locations. San Francisco on May 6, and London on September 23. Additional details regarding speakers and agenda will be announced closer to the event dates. Who should attend? Senior leaders focused on developer productivity and AI within their engineering organizations. How do I apply to attend? Invite requests have not opened yet. In the meantime you can sign up to be notified when invite requests become available. How can my company sponsor the event? We do not offer sponsorships for DX Annual. DX Annual is intentionally focused on content quality and peer-to-peer conversations. Our priority is creating a high-signal experience for attendees without vendor influence. As the event evolves, we may explore ways for partners to participate in the future if it meaningfully adds value for attendees. Is the event free? DX Annual is a paid, ticketed conference. Pricing details will be announced when registration launches. Can I attend both the North America and Europe events? You are welcome to request an invite to attend both events. Each will feature its own program and speaker lineup. Can I request a visa invitation letter? Yes. DX can provide an official visa invitation letter once your registration is confirmed. You can request the letter by contacting the DX Annual team at [contact omitted] . Please allow 3–5 business days for processing. Will 2027 sessions be streamed or recorded? DX Annual is designed primarily as an in-person experience and will not offer live streamed sessions. Select sessions will be recorded and shared post-event. Were the 2026 sessions recorded? Select sessions were recorded and recordings can be found on the past sessions page . I am interested in speaking at DX Annual. How do I submit my interest? You can submit your speaking interest in our formal CFP process here . We review all submissions on a rolling basis and will be in touch if there is a fit for the program. If you do not hear back by January 30th, 2027, you were unfortunately not chosen for the program. What should I know before applying to speak at DX Annual? Below are some key considerations for applying to speak at DX Annual. Deadline: The deadline to submit your talk to the CFP is December 20th, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT. Late submissions will not be considered. Presentation: You do not need a finalized presentation to submit your talk. We require a working title and a short abstract. Once your talk is accepted, the DX Annual team will work with you to refine your content. Content: We're still finalizing our content throughline, but we are focusing on real-world stories of success/failure, actionable takeaways, technical insights, and interesting frameworks. We want new content that our audience finds exciting - please do not recycle your talk tracks. Who can I contact with additional questions? Email the DX Annual team at [contact omitted] . Speaker Applications Help shape the conversation The call for speakers for our 2027 events in San Francisco and London is now open.
